+    def record_click_safely(
+        self,
+        link: Link,
+        referrer: str | None,
+        user_agent: str | None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Protect redirects when analytics persistence has transient failures."""
+
+        try:
+            self.record_click(link, referrer, user_agent)
+            return True
+        except Exception:
+            self.repository.session.rollback()
+            logger.exception("analytics_recording_failed")
+            return False
